about: Each case is a violation planted in project/, in plan.md, in the work report (report.md), in the verification profile or in the evidence that 'work' leaves (review stage). 'code' names the rule of cg.py evidence --rerun that finds its part, or null when only judgement can. '@plan', '@report' and '@profile' are the plan, the work report and .cg-docs/verification.md of the built project. A finding catches a case when its pointer is 'file' at the line that holds 'text', three lines either way, or is one of 'or', where 'record' is a record under .cg-docs/evidence/. 'work' is the work as it went: for each slice the checks that ran, on the files as they were then, which 'earlier' gives as a text of the final file and the text it held.

review.flag: a check of the plan that never ran
a check that fails on the work as it now is
a statistic with no independent check
an expected value derived the same way as the output
a number that measures something else
a claim of validation with no record
